# pve_ha_resource_relocate (Action)

Relocate an HA resource to another node (with fencing semantics).

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "pve_ha_resource_relocate" "example" {
  config {
    node = "pve1"
    sid  = "CHANGE_ME"
  }
}

# terraform_data is a no-op stand-in; wire action.pve actions to the
# lifecycle events of any managed resource.
resource "terraform_data" "trigger" {
  lifecycle {
    action_trigger {
      events  = [after_create]
      actions = [action.pve_ha_resource_relocate.example]
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Target node.
- `sid` (String) HA resource ID. This consists of a resource type followed by a resource specific name, separated with colon (example: vm:100 / ct:100). For virtual machines and containers, you can simply use the VM or CT id as a shortcut (example: 100).
